kod_metni:
import yfinance as yf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

# EMA hesaplama fonksiyonu
def calculate_ema(data, window):
    return data['Close'].ewm(span=window, adjust=False).mean()

# Fibonacci seviyelerini hesaplama fonksiyonu
def calculate_fibonacci(data):
    max_price = data['Close'].max()
    min_price = data['Close'].min()
    difference = max_price - min_price
    levels = {
        '0.236': max_price - 0.236 * difference,
        '0.382': max_price - 0.382 * difference,
        '0.618': max_price - 0.618 * difference,
        '0.786': max_price - 0.786 * difference,
        '1': min_price,
        '0': max_price
    }
    return levels

# Tek bir hisse (örneğin DOAS.IS) için grafik çizimi
stock = 'DOAS.IS'
data = yf.download(stock, period='1y')

# EMA'ları hesapla
data['EMA_10'] = calculate_ema(data, 10)
data['EMA_20'] = calculate_ema(data, 20)
data['EMA_50'] = calculate_ema(data, 50)
data['EMA_100'] = calculate_ema(data, 100)
data['EMA_200'] = calculate_ema(data, 200)

# Fibonacci seviyelerini hesapla
fibonacci_levels = calculate_fibonacci(data)

# Grafik çizimi
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
plt.plot(data['Close'], label=f'{stock} Fiyatı', color='blue')
plt.plot(data['EMA_10'], label='EMA 10', color='green')
plt.plot(data['EMA_20'], label='EMA 20', color='red')
plt.plot(data['EMA_50'], label='EMA 50', color='purple')
plt.plot(data['EMA_100'], label='EMA 100', color='brown')
plt.plot(data['EMA_200'], label='EMA 200', color='orange')

# Fibonacci seviyelerini grafiğe ekle ve etiketle
for level, value in fibonacci_levels.items():
    plt.axhline(value, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label=f'Fibonacci {level}')
    plt.text(data.index[-1], value, f'{level} ({value:.2f})', color='blue', alpha=0.7, va='center')

# EMA'ların son değerlerini yanlarına yazdır
plt.text(data.index[-1], data['EMA_10'].iloc[-1], f'{data["EMA_10"].iloc[-1]:.2f}', color='green', va='center')
plt.text(data.index[-1], data['EMA_20'].iloc[-1], f'{data["EMA_20"].iloc[-1]:.2f}', color='red', va='center')
plt.text(data.index[-1], data['EMA_50'].iloc[-1], f'{data["EMA_50"].iloc[-1]:.2f}', color='purple', va='center')
plt.text(data.index[-1], data['EMA_100'].iloc[-1], f'{data["EMA_100"].iloc[-1]:.2f}', color='brown', va='center')
plt.text(data.index[-1], data['EMA_200'].iloc[-1], f'{data["EMA_200"].iloc[-1]:.2f}', color='orange', va='center')

plt.title(f'{stock} - Fiyat ve EMA\'lar ile Fibonacci Seviyeleri')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
